Materia Collective proudly presents, in collaboration with ArenaNet:

Guild Wars 2: Original Soundtrack - 4xLP Vinyl Record Box Set

Experience the music of Guild Wars 2 in its most deluxe physical form with this expansive 4LP vinyl boxset, pressed on striking Dragon Blood Red and Dragon Scale White 180g vinyl. Designed for collectors and longtime fans alike, this premium edition captures the sweeping orchestral soundscape that defined ArenaNet’s landmark MMO.

Since its debut, Guild Wars 2 has reached millions of players worldwide and earned a reputation for its player-driven storytelling, dynamic event system, and fast-paced cooperative combat. The soundtrack is central to that identity, underscoring vast exploration, large-scale encounters, and the unfolding conflict at the heart of Tyria, now preserved here across four LPs in a bold, shelf-worthy presentation.

This edition is designed to stand proudly at the center of any video game music collection.

Music composed primarily by Jeremy Soule.

Release Notes

  • 4xLP deluxe release for ArenaNet’s acclaimed MMORPG, Guild Wars 2
  • Pressed on heavyweight Dragon Blood Red and Dragon Scale White vinyl

Product images are mockups and are subject to change without notice. The final product may differ from what is shown.
